regime_context: The Canadian detector shows a broad two-horse leadership race: Oil & Gas Producers dominant (eligible, breadth 0.786, durability 0.68, crowded) over a Gold Miners challenger with weak breadth (0.267). Rotation is not one-narrative; the gate helps on this history, so trend discipline is the one leg to weight. Note track_record dir_accuracy is 0.343 (below coin-flip on direction), so conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watch Gold Miners (XGD.TO) as a possible challenger to Oil & Gas: it is rank-2 with a 1.11 score but weak breadth 0.267. The leadership handoff only becomes confirmed if XGD.TO overtakes XEG.TO on a 10-day rolling relative-strength basis while its breadth expands above 0.5 — otherwise it stays a single-name miner story, not a rotation.
